Personal Qualities

We believe you are:

title: Warehouse & Distribution Coordinator
description:
Our Aftermarket operations ensure that spare parts and accessories reach customers with the right quality and at the right time. The Warehouse & Distribution Coordinator plays an important role in this flow, connecting warehousing, transportation, sales, sourcing and external logistics partners. The position focuses on reliable deliveries, efficient distribution and continuous process improvement. You will work with third-party logistics providers in Sweden and contribute to developing an effective end-to-end distribution chain that responds to both business requirements and customer needs.

About the role

As Warehouse & Distribution Coordinator, you will be responsible for the aftermarket delivery of spare parts and accessories from warehouse to customer. You will have direct responsibility for our third-party logistics warehouses for Parts & Accessories in Stigamo and Norrköping, as well as indirect responsibility for other warehouses and transportation solutions used within aftermarket.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Managing and developing the operational collaboration with our 3PL partners

    Ensuring high delivery quality, supporting On-Time-In-Full reporting and minimizing customer claims

About you

We are looking for someone who has:

    A couple of years of experience within supply chain
    A university degree in engineering, or equivalent relevant experience
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    Experience from warehouse and distribution operations is considered a plus

To succeed in this role, you are analytical, structured and comfortable working with data to identify areas for improvement. You take ownership of your responsibilities and have the ability to turn insights into practical actions.

As the role includes collaboration with several internal and external stakeholders, you are communicative and relationship-oriented, while also being able to challenge existing ways of working in a constructive manner. You have a customer-focused mindset and enjoy driving continuous improvement in a dynamic supply chain environment.

Huskvarna, Sweden.

title: Product Planner
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Do you want to be part of creating the best customer offer, driving profitable growth and strengthening our customer offer? Are you looking for a role where your analysis and actions really make a difference? Then this is the opportunity for you!

H&M Assortment is a dynamic international workplace where high pace and rapid changes are natural parts of our day. This is where we design and develop our fashion collections for a wide variety of customers all over the world. H&M Assortment work cross-functional in diverse teams to create H&M's best customer offer and experience – making it possible for everyone to look and feel good in a sustainable way.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will constantly follow, react and identify new sales opportunities based on selling, customer insights and surrounding analysis. With strong analytical skills, a commercial mindset, and salesmanship, you ensure the right assortment impact across regions to maximise growth and profitability. Analysing the selling data of our products and optimise the assortment planning and quantification on your category.

Acting in line with H&M values, you will drive the income and quantification strategy for your category through cross-functional collaboration, working closely with a business controller and having a close collaboration with other teams including pattern makers, designers, and product developers. You will drive and ensure that our global assortment is locally relevant and optimised for each region.

Key Responsibilities:

Responsible to optimise the best regional customer offer by using quantification and sales analysis, leveraging customer and competitors' insights.

    Understanding our customers and their demands for long- and short-term actions. Identify risks and opportunities from a planning perspective based on the set assortment strategy per region. Support the Business Controller in driving regional strategy through quantification, planning, and structured follow-up.
    With a curious and driven selling mindset, conduct sales analysis of our products to identify patterns and translate them into actionable conclusions with the aim to make an impact and maximise the totality.
    Manage and optimise stock flow between regions and channels, taking responsibility for effective moves and transitions.
    -Demonstrate salesmanship & urgency for outcome. Bring a solution-oriented, positive, and agile mindset to change and complexity, driving clear action focus and follow-through.
    Create best collaboration with the team and relevant stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

    Degree within business related areas, textile fashion or an equivalent area
    Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn your analysis into actions
    Business and commercial mindset
    Strong communication skills
    Fluent in English, both written and verbally
    Experience from planning, merchandising, buying, or purchasing is meriting
    Experience within e-commerce is meritorious

And people who are:

    Self-motivated and take ownership to learn and to seek opportunities to improve ways of working.  
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a passion for continuously refining planning and quantification methods.  
    Have a strong business sense by prioritizing time and effort based on potential business impact, focusing on actions that deliver the greatest value and will make the biggest difference.  
    Communicating with impact and seeing patterns in our data.
    Engaging team player and self-motivated to drive goals and thrive in an entrepreneurial setting.

JOIN US

This is a fulltime position based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. You don't have to live in Sweden already, we welcome applications from all parts of the world and offer relocation support if needed.

We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team and our start date is flexible (throughout 2026). We work proactively and review applications continuously. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application if you are completing your studies or other commitments in 2026.

Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

    All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount include H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET and Afound
    In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

After completing the assessment, you will receive feedback with the score you obtained. title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

    Collaboration with radiation oncology, palliative care and other specialties.

Depending on your experience and professional interests, there are opportunities to further develop specific areas of expertise within the department.

Why this opportunity?

    

Collaborative and supportive environment:

Join an experienced oncology team known for its strong collegial atmosphere, close cooperation and willingness to support one another.

    

Modern oncology practice:

Work in a department that continuously follows developments in cancer treatment and offers access to innovative therapies and evidence-based care.

    

Professional development:

Benefit from ongoing opportunities for continuing medical education, subspecialization and participation in developing multidisciplinary tumour teams.

    

Varied clinical work:

Combine outpatient care, inpatient responsibilities, multidisciplinary collaboration and specialised oncology treatments within a broad clinical practice.

    

Long-term career opportunities:

Become part of a stable department with low staff turnover and a strong commitment to quality improvement and professional growth.

Life in central Sweden

The position is located in a scenic region of central Sweden, offering an excellent quality of life with forests, lakes and coastline within easy reach. The area combines a welcoming community atmosphere with modern infrastructure, short commuting times and access to outdoor activities throughout the year.

title: Senior Business Controller  Sales & Services
description:
Do you thrive on turning financial data into business insights that influence decisions on a global scale? At business area Rock Processing and Crushing Solutions Division, you’re at the center of transforming our global sales and service performance, helping drive transparency, planning, and continuous improvement across our international organization.

About the job

You support global sales and service activities through financial analysis, performance management, forecasting, and business partnering. Your work drives transparency in commercial performance, supports decision-making across regions, and contributes to the continuous improvement of financial processes and governance. You report to the Director of Business Control.

Job responsibilities

    Monitor, analyze, and report on global sales and service performance, including orders, revenues, margins, costs, and key business drivers.
    Support forecasting, target-setting, budgeting activities, and scenario analysis.
    Provide financial insights and decision support to Sales and Service management, stakeholders, and the Director of Business Control.
    Develop and maintain management reporting, dashboards, and business analysis that strengthen transparency and business understanding.
    Drive improvements in financial processes, data quality, and internal controls.
    Ensure compliance with internal frameworks and applicable regulations.

Location

The position is preferably based in Svedala, Sweden. Global collaboration and occasional travel may be required.

Your profile

You bring solid experience within business control, financial planning and analysis, or commercial controlling. A strong understanding of sales and service business models helps you connect financial performance with business outcomes and provide valuable decision support.

Your background includes

    Experience in business control with a focus on sales, service, aftermarket, or commercial operations.
    A university degree in finance, business administration, economics, or a related field.
    Experience with forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and performance follow-up in a global matrix organization.
    Experience analyzing financial and operational drivers across regions in an international business environment.
    Good knowledge of ERP systems, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions.
    Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to explain financial insights to non-finance stakeholders.

Success in this position comes from combining strong analytical capabilities with a business-oriented mindset. You work in a structured and proactive way, enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across different geographies, and are comfortable navigating a dynamic, data-driven environment focused on continuous improvement.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. title: Expert Technical Writer
description:
Job Description

As an Expert Technical Writer, you will drive the overall content strategy and quality standards across multiple repositories, ensuring alignment with established guidelines and long-term documentation goals. You’ll act as a trusted subject matter advisor for documentation practices, partnering with contributors and stakeholders to elevate content quality, improve consistency, and shape how technical knowledge is communicated to users. You will lead content reviews, define best practices, mentor contributors, and identify opportunities to improve documentation processes and governance. Your work will ensure that all content is clear, scalable, user-focused, and aligned with the needs of both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you’ll do

    Lead and drive content reviews across multiple repositories with exceptional attention to detail.
    Establish, evolve, and advocate for documentation standards, style guides, and best practices to maintain consistent content quality at scale.
    Translate complex technical information into clear, structured, and user-focused content tailored to different audiences.
    Own and improve documentation governance processes, ensuring adherence to content guidelines and identifying opportunities for optimization.
    Partner with senior technical stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather information, align on documentation priorities, and support high-impact initiatives.
    Mentor and support contributors by providing thoughtful feedback, coaching, and guidance on writing quality and content structure.
    Identify content gaps, inconsistencies, and usability issues, proactively driving improvements across the documentation ecosystem.
    Handle a variety of complex content-related queries and documentation challenges.
    Collaborate transversally with other teams to strengthen knowledge-sharing practices and improve the overall documentation experience.

Qualifications

We are looking for a thoughtful and highly collaborative individual with a strong passion for content quality, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. You enjoy working with technical experts, shaping documentation practices, and helping teams communicate complex ideas effectively. You are comfortable providing guidance across teams and contributing to documentation strategy in a fast-evolving environment. Besides the above, we’re looking for someone aligned with our core values and the following skills and experience:

    Exceptional writing, editing, and content structuring skills in English.
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to provide constructive and actionable feedback.
    Experience driving documentation quality standards, content governance, or large-scale documentation initiatives.
    Ability to work strategically while remaining hands-on with content creation and editing.
    Strong collaborative mindset with experience working across multidisciplinary teams.
    Background in technical writing, developer documentation, or software development preferred.
    Familiarity with Confluence, Git, games, or game engines is a bonus.

title: ASIC Design Engineering Manager, Lund
description:
Lead the Next Generation of ARTPEC™ Innovation! High-quality, innovative SoC/ASIC designs are critical to Axis's continued growth and future success. As we push the boundaries of cutting-edge technology with demanding requirements for low power, high performance, and security, we're expanding our ASIC department to meet the evolving challenges of next-generation data processing.

Latest news on Axis SoC: https://newsroom.axis.com/tag/artpec

What is Axis?
Axis is a fast growing and highly innovative company that offers intelligent security solutions. We are market leaders in network and surveillance cameras and are using this as the core around our solutions to create a safer and smarter world. Our success is largely due to our highly skilled staff and our strong culture of daring to succeed and allowing ourselves to constantly break new ground. The people here at Axis are innovative, dedicated and energetic and for us it is not just about creating products - we form and shape industry leading solutions giving highest values to our customers.

Now we are looking for a passionate leader to head our ASIC Design team.

What will I do?
As the Engineering Manager you will have overall responsibility for the ASIC Design team.

    You will lead, coach and develop a team of highly skilled ASIC and FPGA engineers, creating a collaborate environment for people to perform, grow and take ownership. You will build a strong and inclusive team culture, set clear expectations and priorities, and support both experienced experts and emerging talents in their development.
    You are comfortable leading highly experienced specialists and creating the arena for them to succeed. You know when to provide direction, when to challenge and when to step back and let the experts lead.
    You will work close with your project manager and the Technology department to develop the next generation of ARTPECs, driving strategic technical direction and ensuring alignment with our product roadmap and future vision.
    You will do the planning, budgeting, resource allocation and day-to-day operations, ensuring optimal team performance, project delivery, and efficient resource utilization across multiple complex ASIC development cycles.
    You will be part of dynamic and expanding management teams in the ASIC and in the Technology departments, contributing to strategic decision-making and shaping the future direction of hardware innovation at Axis.
    You will lead and support organizational, methodology and process development, spearheading advancements in our design methodologies, tools, and processes to maintain our cutting-edge capabilities and efficiency.
    You will participate in cross functional project steering groups representing the ASIC team and ensuring seamless integration and collaboration with broader product development initiatives.
    …and depending on your interests and ambitions maybe even more?

Who are we looking for?
We seek a visionary leader with a profound passion for both cutting-edge technology development and empowering high-performing engineering teams. You thrive on fostering a stimulating, creative, and collaborative environment.

With a track record in technically demanding landscapes, you confidently provide architectural oversight and strategic vision, successfully navigating the complexities of advanced R&D environments.

Parallel to managing your own team we want you to have an enthusiasm for active participation in our leadership team to drive strategic initiatives, cross-functional alignment, and foster a healthy, unified culture across the entire multi-site department.

You are an ambitious and initiative-taking person that has good leadership skills with the ability to motivate the people around you and visualize the direction going ahead.

You have previous experience leading engineering teams as a team lead, project manager or formal people management.

The ASIC Design team
Your team, the core of our ARTPEC innovation, is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing the sophisticated hardware modules that provide Axis with an undeniable competitive edge. We tackle complex challenges in real-time image processing, advanced video compression, and state-of-the-art computer vision, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in surveillance technology using the latest techniques and tools.

The team also hosts the competence center for FPGA design at Axis. The FPGA designers assist in technology selections, methodology setup as well as participating in exciting product projects.

The team takes pride in delivering top-quality work using the latest techniques.

What Axis has to offer
Axis is an organization that values creativity and promotes teamwork and openness. With us, you will grow both personally and professionally within areas such as:

    Impact: Influence the next generations of ARTPEC and technology that is at the heart of Axis' products.
    Leadership: Lead highly skilled engineers in a culture where expertise, innovation and collaboration are highly valued.
    Strategic exposure: Be part of management teams and contribute to decisions shaping the future direction of hardware development.
    Growth: Develop your leadership, organizational and strategic capabilities in a global technology company. We have both Leadership and Mentorship programs supporting you in your journey.
    Culture: Work in an open and collaborative environment with strong technical communities and opportunities to build relationships across the organization.

Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. Would you like to grow with us?

Find out more from our recruiting Director Patrik Lislén on phone +46 46 272 1800.

We review applications continuously.

See you around!

title: HVDC System Design Engineer for backbone
description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about engineering and problem solving? Maybe you are – or want to become – an expert within HVDC?  Then this opportunity is for you!  

We are currently looking for HVDC System Design Engineers. In this role you are responsible for the electrical design and functionality of HVDC converter stations, focusing on the high-voltage system, including main circuit design, insulation coordination and harmonic design.

This advertisement is for the backbone office within HVDC System Design department, where your main task is to support the project execution offices by improving base design and ways of working.

This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

    Actively contribute in internal transformation projects and initiatives.
    Effectively participate in problem-solving discussions where you can present your work, discuss challenges and propose a path forward on a higher level.

    Take responsibility for your work activities, deliver with quality and on time.
    Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

Your background

    You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with focus on Power Systems or Power Electronics.
    You have a general understanding of electrical power systems and its equipments.
    You encounter problems with a practical engineering mindset, understanding that models and calculations are estimations. But also, that input data could be arbitrary and that some requirements must be challenged and discussed to solve real problems.
    You are a team player with excellent communication and report writing skills.
    Fluent in English both written and verbal.
    Programming experience in MATLAB and Python, and experience of EMT tools like PSCAD is highly advantageous. Experience of working in Azure DevOps is also beneficial.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Are you passionate about Agile delivery and empowering teams to achieve their full potential? We are looking for a Scrum Master to lead and support high-performing cross-functional teams, facilitating Agile ceremonies, removing impediments, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In this role, you will collaborate closely with product owners, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to drive successful delivery, strengthen Agile maturity, and ensure teams remain focused on delivering exceptional business value in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

·        Lead the scrum team using Agile methodology and Scrum practices;

title: Business Controller, Purchasing & Finance
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a role where finance and purchasing meet. In this assignment, you help a global company in industrial and marine solutions make better financial decisions across purchasing strategy, supplier investments, and business development. You work closely with purchasing, central Finance, and Business Control, which gives you broad exposure to both operational questions and longer-term planning.

This role suits you if you enjoy turning numbers into clear business guidance and want to influence decisions in a cross-functional environment with many stakeholders. It is an interesting opportunity because you get to combine classic controlling with purchasing-related analysis, business cases, and improvement work in a broad business setting.

Job Description

    You drive monthly closing analyses, reporting, and follow-up of KPIs and performance indicators.
    You prepare estimates, forecasts, and scenario analyses that support business and purchasing decisions.
    You analyze investments linked to vendor tooling, capacity, risk, and resourcing.
    You provide financial input to investigations, improvement initiatives, and purchasing-related projects.
    You handle supplier invoice-related issues and help resolve deviations.
    You build and evaluate business cases, including material cost assessments and financial impact analyses.
    You support buyers and project managers with guidance on financial processes, routines, and ways of working.
    You contribute to additional purchasing-related topics such as regulatory follow-up and special projects when needed.

Requirements

    Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
    2 to 5 years of experience in a Business Controller role.
    Strong knowledge of finance systems such as SAP, Essbase, or equivalent.
    Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365.
    Fluent English, both written and spoken.
    Ability to complete a background check before start.

Nice to have

    Experience within Purchasing.

title: Regulatory Specialist
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world's largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you ready to help shape the regulatory foundation for one of Europe's most exciting space initiatives?

If you answer yes to this question, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Regulatory Specialist within our Business Area Orbital Launch & Rocket Test. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity and Courage.  

As Regulatory Specialist, you will join the team supporting the regulatory and licensing activities connected to SSC Space’s orbital launch ambitions and launch services. In this role, you will contribute to license applications, regulatory analysis and the continued development of processes for future launch operations. You will have the opportunity to develop your expertise within the team and gradually take on greater responsibility.

We believe you have:

    A university degree in Law, Political Science, Public Administration, International Relations, European Studies or a related field.
    Up to three years of relevant professional experience, or have recently graduated with strong academic credentials and a clear interest in regulatory affairs.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.
    Strong analytical and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical actions and decision material.  
    An interest in legislation, licensing, compliance and international regulatory frameworks.
    A structured, proactive and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently while coordinating multiple stakeholders.

Experience within aerospace, defence, export control, government authorities, compliance or other regulated industries is considered an advantage but is not required.

In this role you will:

    Coordinate regulatory and licensing activities related to SSC Space orbital launch ambitions and launch services.
    Prepare, manage and follow up license applications for launch vehicles, payloads and associated space activities.
    Develop and establish regulatory processes, governance structures and compliance frameworks supporting future launch operations.
    Monitor, interpret and communicate national and international regulations affecting launch services, satellite operations, export control and related activities.
    Serve as SSC Space point of contact towards authorities, government agencies, industry stakeholders and international regulatory organizations.
    Support customers and internal stakeholders by providing guidance on licensing requirements and regulatory compliance throughout project lifecycles.

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year and Ascension Day.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.  
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including attractive pension plans, parental pay and insurance.

Location

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna or SSC Space Headquarters in Solna

Further Information

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com

Next Step

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Due to the security and regulatory requirements associated with this position, applicants must hold citizenship in an EU member state.  

We help Earth benefit from Space

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com.

title: PhD Student in Applied Geophysics
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

Luleå University of Technology, together with the Geological Survey of Sweden and several Swedish industrial partners, is launching a multidisciplinary research project on natural hydrogen resource development and underground hydrogen storage.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate in Applied Geophysics to contribute to this exciting project which offers a unique opportunity to work with leading researchers and industry partners to address one of the key challenges of the energy transition.

As a doctoral student, you will receive excellent supervision, access to advanced research facilities, and opportunities to develop into an internationally recognized researcher.

Subject description

Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.

Project description

For this PhD position, the research will focus on evaluating the potential of natural hydrogen production in Norrbotten County in Sweden using an integrated field and numerical modeling approach. Your tasks are to:

- reprocess and jointly model the available regional magnetotelluric (MT), gravity and magnetic data to develop an initial model for screening the subsurface to select areas with H2-potential source rocks;

- acquire and process new MT and controlled-source electromagnetic (CSEM) field data in targeted areas;

- perform integrated 3D modelling of MT, CSEM and gravity or magnetic data from targeted areas to characterise potential natural hydrogen production systems;

- perform model verification and selection of sites with optimum potential for hydrogen generation.

The project is carried out in close collaboration between Luleå University of Technology, the Geological Survey of Sweden, and several Swedish industrial partners. The successful candidate will work closely with researchers specializing in rock mechanics, underground construction, geophysics and geology, while interacting regularly with industrial stakeholders.

Duties

As a PhD student, you will:

- conduct independent research combining field investigations and numerical modelling of multimodal data (taking into account subsurface structural complexity and anisotropy);

- develop methodologies for evaluating and ranking natural hydrogen prospectivity in Norrbotten region;

- publish research findings in leading international scientific journals;

- present research at national and international conferences;

- complete doctoral coursework required for the degree.

The majority of your working time will be devoted to doctoral research. Depending on departmental needs, you may also have the opportunity to gain experience in teaching and supervision.

You will become a member of the Network of Young Scientists (NYS) within CH2ESS, which organizes workshops, field excursions, interdisciplinary networking activities and professional development events.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold an MSc degree (or equivalent) in one of the following areas:

- Geophysics

- Physics (with specialization in electromagnetism or computational physics)

- or a closely related discipline.

A driving license is essential since geophysical fieldwork is required in this project.  Experience in geophysical fieldwork is an advantage. A good background in numerical modelling of geophysical data is also an advantage.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

- strong analytical and problem-solving skills;

- enthusiasm for scientific research;

- ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams;

- excellent communication skills in written and spoken English.

Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage because some fieldwork, industrial interaction and teaching activities may require communication in Swedish, but it is not a mandatory requirement.

Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. The expected start date for the position is October-December 2026.

title: Industrielektriker till HFSAB
description:
Om företaget

HFSAB is the world's leading supplier of continuous lead extruders with over 60 years of experience in design and manufacture of high-quality machines for cable sheathing. Our portfolio comprises equipment for lead extrusion from single machines to complete turnkey solutions as well as equipment for cable stripping, repair and recovery. Consistent development over decades, staff expertise, service as a core competence and close partnership with our customers have contributed to our success. Our machine components are designed in-house. High stock availability together with a network of established high-quality sub-suppliers for parts provide for consistently high quality and speedy availability. These core competences have been our fundamental claim in the past and will be in future. As an affiliated company of the NIEHOFF Group with several branches worldwide, and with headquarters in Motala, Sweden, HFSAB is an innovative company with the goal and ability in meeting the global demands of tomorrow already today.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som industrielektriker hos oss blir dina huvudsakliga uppgifter att arbeta med elinstallationer samt övervakning av installationer, där du säkerställer att arbetet utförs korrekt och enligt standard. En viktig del i rollen är även dokumentation och strukturering av information, för att skapa tydlighet och långsiktig kunskap i organisationen.

Vi uppskattar om du bidrar med idéer och engagemang kring hur vi kan förbättra vårt underlag och dokumentationsrutiner – här finns utrymme för att påverka och utveckla arbetssättet.

Tjänsten innefattar emellanåt resor både inom Sverige och internationellt, där du representerar företaget och möter kunder. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs i kontakt med människor och i en varierande arbetsmiljö.

Du blir en del av ett team på sju personer med bred kompetens inom både el och mekanik.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är utbildad elektriker och gärna har erfarenhet av arbete som industrielektriker. Du har goda kunskaper inom installation och felsökning av el på maskiner och är van att lösa problem praktiskt. El-behörighet är meriterande, men om du är på väg mot att färdigställa den kan vi stötta dig i processen.

Som person beskrivs du som självdrivande, initiativtagande och strukturerad. Du ser värdet i att dokumentera och dela kunskap – för att skapa en stabil grund som fler kan bygga vidare på. Du uppskattar variation i arbetet, där både teknik, dokumentation och kundkontakt ingår. Tjänsten kräver att du kommunicerar obehindrat i svenska och engelska samt att du innehar B-körkort.

Ansökningsförfarande

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar HFSAB med Skill. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Innan anställning slutförs kommer bakgrundskontroll genomföras.

Eftersom vi vill säkerställa ett rättvist och fördomsfritt urvalsarbete önskar vi inget personligt brev, däremot att du svarar på våra inledande urvalsfrågor. Om du går vidare kommer du därefter att få ett mejl med en länk till våra rekryteringstester som på ett objektivt sätt hjälper oss att matcha rätt person till tjänsten.

Vid frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Matilda Ingeson på matilda.ingeson@skill.se eller 0705-65 61 31. #LI-DNI

title: Chef/Kock
description:
We are looking for a skilled chef to join the team at ÄNG. You will become part of a close-knit and ambitious kitchen team, with a varied role and plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and contribute.

Experience from a Michelin-starred restaurant is a plus, but not a requirement. A good foundation in fine dining, attention to detail and a genuine interest in cooking are more important to us. We work hard and have high ambitions, but we also believe that a good kitchen should be a friendly and enjoyable place to work.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the EU/EEA.



ABOUT ÄNG

ÄNG serves a tasting menu based on Nordic ingredients. The restaurant is open for dinner Monday to Friday, with a separate tasting menu served for breakfast Tuesday to Saturday. We close after breakfast service on Saturday and reopen at 17:00 on Monday.

Our cooking is rooted in Halland, while drawing on techniques and influences from around the world. We work mainly with ingredients from the surrounding area and adapt the menu to what is available throughout the seasons.

With the sea around 20 minutes away, seafood and ingredients from the coastline are an important part of the menu. We also work with produce from nearby farms, forests, beaches and fields, including ingredients picked locally each morning.

ÄNG is located at Ästad Vingård, and the vineyard’s organic Scandinavian wines are produced around 100 metres from the restaurant.

Working with a limited geographical area naturally sets some boundaries. For the kitchen team, this means finding new ways to work with the ingredients and conditions available to us.

ÄNG is run by Ann-Catrine Gemzell (General Manager & Sommelier) and Filip Gemzell (Executive Chef).



WHY JOIN ÄNG?

    You will have a personal development plan, set up accordingly to your ambitions and goals.
    The team is always there to help you succeed, as long as you help the team to succeed.
    A great opportunity to connect with nature, vineyards and produce. We can provide assistance with finding accommodation.



APPLY

Apply by sending your CV and cover letter to executive chef Filip Gemzell, at filip@restaurangang.se.

Feel free to get in touch if you have any questions!

title: Site Manager - Swedish student websites
description:
About the Role

Are you passionate about SEO, UX, data, and digital growth? Do you enjoy turning insights into improvements that create better user experiences and measurable business results?

We're looking for a Site Manager to take ownership of our Swedish student websites, including studentum.se, AllaStudier.se, gymnasium.se, anpassadgymnasieskola.se, and dingrundskola.se. In this role, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive traffic, improve conversions, and continuously develop some of Sweden's leading education platforms.

As Site Manager, you'll be responsible for the overall development and performance of our websites. You'll work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, Content, and Sales to improve the user experience, strengthen our SEO performance, and deliver digital projects that create real impact.

From analyzing user behaviour and planning site improvements to collaborating on new product features, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our student platforms.

About the Team

You'll join a collaborative team of Marketing Specialists and Account Managers dedicated to creating the best possible experience for both our education partners and prospective students. Together, we ensure our websites provide valuable content, intuitive functionality, and user-friendly tools that help schools connect with the right audience.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Service Delivery, you'll work closely with Site Managers across our international markets, sharing insights, best practices, and ideas to continuously improve our platforms. You'll also collaborate closely with our Product, Tech, and SEO teams, where our SEO & growth specialists provide the strategic direction while you help bring those initiatives to life through continuous website optimization, content improvements, and user-focused development.

Responsibilities

    

Own and develop the structure and user experience of our Swedish student websites.

    

Analyze website performance, traffic, and conversion data to identify growth opportunities.

    

Drive SEO initiatives to increase organic visibility and website traffic.

    

Monitor competitors, digital trends, and developments in the Swedish education system to keep our platforms relevant, accurate, and competitive.

    

Define user needs through research, surveys, and customer insights.

    

Collaborate with Product and Tech teams to prioritize new features, report bugs, and implement improvements.

    

Work closely with Content Managers to optimize and develop high-quality contenting.

title: Data Engineer - Sustainability & ESG Reporting, Solna
description:
PostNord is making a significant investment in strengthening its sustainability and ESG reporting capabilities towards customers as part of our data‑driven transformation. To support this journey, we are building a new ESG data foundation – and we are looking for an ESG Data Engineer to help define and build it. This is a key role in a new setup, where you will contribute to establishing trusted, scalable and auditable ESG data pipelines that sustainability reporting across the Group will rely on. You will help turn ESG reporting requirements into reliable data solutions from the ground up. The role sits within the Analytics Center of Excellence, responsible for shaping the future data and analytics landscape at PostNord. You will work with our Azure‑based data platform and collaborate closely with sustainability specialists. This position is ideal for someone who wants to take real responsibility, build something fundamental and apply strong technical skills in a purpose‑driven domain.

Your role

As a Data Engineer working with Sustainability & ESG, you will design and maintain data models and pipelines that support:

    Regulatory and statutory sustainability reporting (e.g. CSRD)

    Internal sustainability KPIs and performance management

    Management and operational insights related to climate impact, energy, transport, suppliers, and social responsibility

You will work closely with sustainability experts, business stakeholders, Power BI developers, and the central data platform team to ensure data quality, traceability, and scalability.

Job duties

    Enable a self-service data architecture that provides trusted sustainability and ESG data across the organization

    Design, develop, and deploy fact- and dimension-based data models to support sustainability reporting and analytics

    Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating data from multiple operational, finance, and external sources

    Collaborate with sustainability, finance, and compliance stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into robust data solutions

    Ensure data quality, lineage, and transparency, supporting auditability and regulatory needs

    Collaborate with the Data Platform team to align on architecture standards and best practices

    Work with modern Azure-based data platforms, contributing to scalable and secure solutions

    Strong analytical skills and the ability to apply complex business and sustainability logic to raw data

    Data modeling and data warehousing

    Database design and ETL/ELT development

    Performance tuning and scalable data solutions

    Experience or strong interest in sustainability, ESG, or regulatory reporting domains

    Good understanding of front-end analytics and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI)

    Experience in requirement analysis, prototyping, and stakeholder collaboration

    A collaborative mindset and ability to work closely with business, sustainability specialists, and technical teams
    Preferably hands-on experience with: Databricks, Azure DevOps, Git, (Py)Spark, Python, CI/CD pipelines, Azure Data Platform, Medallion architecture.

Ways of working

You will work in an agile environment, applying a pragmatic SAFe-inspired approach adapted to team and product needs. As a Data Engineer at PostNord, you will remain hands-on, while also collaborating closely with Power BI developers, sustainability specialists, product owners, and domain teams to ensure solutions meet business and regulatory expectations.

Your profile

You have several years of experience as a Data Engineer or BI/Data Engineer in a data-intensive environment. You understand how to design enterprise-grade, reliable, and auditable data models, and you enjoy working close to the business.

You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by using data and technology to support sustainability, transparency, and responsible business practices.

We offer you

    A flexible hybrid workplace in a prestige-free and collaborative culture

    Opportunities for professional and personal development

    A Nordic working environment with strong values

In addition, we offer:

    Good insurance and occupational pension conditions

    Wellness allowance & access to office gym and swimming pool

    Employee benefits through PostNord’s employee foundation

    Employment according to a collective agreement

We make everyday life easier – and more sustainable

PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordics.

We value accountability, courage, and commitment, and we believe diversity and teamwork lead to better outcomes.

Apply

We look forward to receiving your application! For questions about the role, please contact: Pernille Skovborg – Manager of Analytics Center of Excellence at pernille.skovborg@postnord.com.

PostNord offers communications and logistics solutions to, from and within the Nordic region. With our expertise and a unique distribution network, we are developing the basis for tomorrow’s communication, e-commerce, distribution and logistics.

title: Senior Project Manager, Atlassian Cloud Migration
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will lead a strategic migration of a company-wide Atlassian platform from an on-premise setup to Atlassian Cloud. This is a high-visibility program in a complex enterprise environment where technology, information security, risk, compliance, architecture, operations, and business needs all need to move in step.

You will take the program from planning through execution and help secure a smooth, compliant transition with minimal disruption to daily operations. If you enjoy driving cloud transformation in an environment with many stakeholders, clear governance needs, and real business impact, this role offers a meaningful challenge.

Job Description

    You will lead the end-to-end migration program from Atlassian Data Center/Server to Atlassian Cloud.
    You will define and manage scope, timeline, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery structure.
    You will coordinate cross-functional teams across infrastructure, platform, security, compliance, architecture, and business functions.
    You will establish governance forums and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
    You will drive stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and change activities to support adoption.
    You will coordinate vendors and partners where needed and keep all moving parts aligned.
    You will ensure the migration follows enterprise architecture, security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
    You will proactively identify issues and risks and turn them into clear actions and decisions.
    You will oversee testing, cutover planning, business readiness, and the transition to operational support.

Requirements

    Proven track record of leading large-scale enterprise transformation or migration programs successfully.
    Minimum 7-10 years of project or program management experience in complex organizations.
    Experience with SaaS transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, or enterprise platform modernization.
    Strong understanding of project delivery methods including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid models.
    Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups and communicate effectively at executive level.
    Experience working with projects that include significant regulatory, risk, and security considerations.
    Strong leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
    Ability to work professionally in both Swedish and English.

Nice to have

    Experience with Atlassian products such as Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Atlassian Cloud migration programs.
    Experience from banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
    Familiarity with data residency, data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements linked to cloud adoption.
    Experience working in large international enterprise environments with distributed teams.
    Project management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Student Assistant
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description:
Studiehandledare på tyska, 50 %

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö söker en engagerad studiehandledare på tyska för en deltidsanställning på 50 %.

Som studiehandledare kommer du att stödja en elev i att utveckla sina kunskaper i olika skolämnen genom studiehandledning på tyska. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med elevens ämneslärare, mentor och övrig berörd personal.Arbetsuppgifter

- Ge studiehandledning på tyska, individuellt eller i mindre grupp.
- Hjälpa eleven att förstå ämnesinnehåll, instruktioner och centrala begrepp.
- Stödja eleven i att använda sina tidigare kunskaper och erfarenheter i den svenska undervisningen.
- Förbereda och följa upp undervisningsinnehåll tillsammans med eleven.
- Samarbeta regelbundet med ämneslärare och mentor för att planera stödet utifrån elevens behov.
- Bidra till att utveckla elevens självständighet, studieteknik och förmåga att delta i undervisningen.
- Dokumentera och följa upp elevens utveckling tillsammans med ansvariga lärare.Vi söker dig som

- har mycket goda kunskaper i tyska,
- har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska,
- kan förklara innehåll tydligt och anpassa ditt språk efter elevens behov,
- har god samarbetsförmåga och ett professionellt förhållningssätt,
- är lugn, ansvarsfull, organiserad och lyhörd,
- delar skolans höga förväntningar på elevernas utveckling samt vårt fokus på trygghet, studiero och lärande.

Pedagogisk utbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som studiehandledare, lärare eller elevassistent är meriterande men inget formellt krav.Anställningsvillkor

- Omfattning: 50 %
- Arbetsplats: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
- Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse

För arbete i skola krävs att du uppvisar ett giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister.

Skicka ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev . Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

German-Speaking Study Guidance Support, 50%

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö is seeking a committed German-speaking study guidance support worker for a 50% part-time position.

In this role, you will support a student in developing their knowledge across different school subjects through study guidance in German. You will work closely with the student’s subject teachers, mentor and other relevant members of staff.Main responsibilities

- Provide study guidance in German, individually or in a small group.
- Help the student understand subject content, instructions and key terminology.
- Support the student in connecting their previous knowledge and experiences with the Swedish curriculum.
- Prepare and follow up learning content together with the student.
- Collaborate regularly with subject teachers and the student’s mentor to plan support according to the student’s needs.
- Help the student develop independence, effective study habits and the ability to participate fully in lessons.
- Document and review the student’s progress together with the responsible teachers.We are looking for someone who

- has an excellent command of German,
- has a good command of Swedish and/or English,
- can explain content clearly and adapt their language to the student’s needs,
- works collaboratively and maintains a professional approach,
- is calm, responsible, organised and responsive,
- shares the school’s high expectations for student progress and our commitment to safety, calm and effective learning.

A teaching or educational qualification, or previous experience as a study guidance support worker, teacher or student assistant, would be advantageous but is not a formal requirement.Employment details

- Scope: 50%
- Workplace: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Start date: By agreement
- Form of employment: By agreement

Employment in a Swedish school requires the successful candidate to present a valid extract from the police criminal-record register.

Please send your CV and a short covering letter. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: Kock inom asiatisk matlagning sökes
description:
SVENSKA

Är du vår nästa kock?

Vi är en restaurangverksamhet med fokus på modern asiatisk mat. Nu söker vi en engagerad kock med intresse för asiatisk matlagning som vill bli en del av vårt team i Malmö.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som tycker om att arbeta med asiatisk mat och trivs i ett kök med högt tempo. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetar effektivt både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:

    Tillagning och förberedelse av asiatiska rätter
    

    Förberedelse av råvaror och mise en place
    

    Matlagning efter våra recept och rutiner
    

    Säkerställa kvalitet, smak och presentation
    

    Hålla köket rent och organiserat
    

    Samarbeta med övriga kollegor för att ge våra gäster en bra upplevelse

Tidigare erfarenhet av asiatisk matlagning är meriterande, men det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad, arbetsvillig och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Tillsvidareanställning
    

    Heltid
    

    Fast månadslön
    

    Arbete både vardagar och helger
    

    Ett trevligt och engagerat team
    

    Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

ENGLISH

Are you our next chef?

We are a restaurant business focusing on modern Asian cuisine. We are now looking for a motivated chef with an interest in Asian cooking to join our team in Malmö.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with Asian food and feels comfortable in a fast-paced kitchen environment. You are responsible, organised and able to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Preparing and cooking Asian dishes
    

    Preparing ingredients and mise en place
    

    Cooking according to our recipes and routines
    

    Maintaining high standards of quality, taste and presentation
    

    Keeping the kitchen clean and organised
    

    Working together with the team to provide our guests with a great experience

Previous experience with Asian cuisine is an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated, hardworking and willing to learn and develop with us.

What we offer

    Permanent employment
    

    Full-time position
    

    Fixed monthly salary
    

    Work on both weekdays and weekends
    

    A friendly and supportive team
    

    Opportunities to develop within the business

TIẾNG VIỆT

Bạn có phải là đầu bếp tiếp theo của chúng tôi?

Chúng tôi là một hệ thống nhà hàng đang phát triển với định hướng ẩm thực châu Á hiện đại. Hiện tại chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một đầu bếp yêu thích ẩm thực châu Á để gia nhập đội ngũ của chúng tôi tại Malmö.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm ai?

Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một người yêu thích công việc bếp và có hứng thú với ẩm thực châu Á. Bạn có tinh thần trách nhiệm, làm việc gọn gàng, nhanh nhẹn và có khả năng làm việc cả độc lập lẫn cùng đồng đội trong môi trường nhà hàng có nhịp độ nhanh.

Công việc bao gồm:

    Chuẩn bị và chế biến các món ăn châu Á
    

    Sơ chế và chuẩn bị nguyên liệu
    

    Nấu ăn theo công thức và quy trình của nhà hàng
    

    Đảm bảo chất lượng, hương vị và cách trình bày món ăn
    

    Giữ khu vực bếp sạch sẽ và ngăn nắp
    

    Phối hợp với đồng nghiệp để mang đến trải nghiệm tốt cho khách hàng

Có kinh nghiệm về ẩm thực châu Á là một lợi thế. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng nhất là bạn chăm chỉ, có trách nhiệm, ham học hỏi và muốn phát triển lâu dài cùng chúng tôi.

Chúng tôi cung cấp

    Việc làm lâu dài
    

    Toàn thời gian
    

    Lương cố định hàng tháng
    

    Làm việc cả ngày thường và cuối tuần
    

    Môi trường làm việc thân thiện
    

    Cơ hội học hỏi và phát triển trong công việc

title: Geotechnical Geologist to Gruvteknik
description:
Do you want to use your geological and geotechnical expertise to solve meaningful challenges in one of the world's most advanced underground mining environments? At LKAB, you will contribute to sustainable mining together with experienced colleagues in a supportive, international team where collaboration, learning and long-term development are central.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geotechnical Geologist, you will help build and develop the geotechnical understanding that supports safe, sustainable and future-oriented underground mining. You will work with data collection, geological and geotechnical modelling, technical studies and project development, always in close cooperation with colleagues from different specialist areas. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute with your expertise while continuing to learn from others across geology, rock mechanics, seismology, numerical modelling and project management. 

In the role, you will for example: 

    Coordinate geotechnical data acquisition, modelling and model application
    Plan and budget drilling programs in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
    Create, maintain and improve geotechnical models
    Contribute to technical studies and reporting
    Participate in infrastructure and mining development projects
    Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders on critical mining studies

What you bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys analysing complex information and translating it into useful insights. You work in a structured way, take initiative when needed and value working together with others. You communicate clearly, ask questions when something needs to be understood more deeply and are motivated by contributing to solutions that make a difference for both operations and people. 

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    A Master of Science degree in Mining Engineering, Engineering Geology, Geology or another related field.
    Experience from exploration geology or engineering geology.
    Experience from underground mining environments.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driving license equivalent to Swedish category B.

It is also an advantage if you have:

    Experience with geotechnical logging and modelling, preferably using Leapfrog.
    Experience with geotechnical databases, such as AcQuire, Imago or Imdex.
    Knowledge of rock mass characterization systems.
    Experience with technical report writing and working with large geotechnical datasets.

We encourage applications from candidates whose experience may not align with every listed requirement but who are enthusiastic about the opportunity, passionate about the industry and confident in their ability to succeed in the role.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Location: Kiruna or Gällivare

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time, daytime

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About our team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What you’ll be doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
    We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
    Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
    Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
    Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
    Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Your background and skills include:

    Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
    Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
